Subject: Interested in pricing + demo (saw CTA on pricing page)

Hi Marissa,

We signed up briefly via your pricing page CTA and indicated we have a mid-six-figure budget band. I'm Sam — Head of Payments at SummitPay. We're evaluating inference providers for a user-facing payments fraud feature and would like a short pricing + product demo to understand fit and run-rate economics.

High-level:
- Volume: ~1.2M requests/mo (expected growth)
- Latency target: ~200ms p95
- Data residency: US, standard SOC2 requirements

Available windows (PST): Mon-Fri after 10am, or Tue/Thu mornings. Prefer a call with a pricing overview + Q&A; 30 minutes should be fine.

Thanks — can you route to the right person or share avail?

Best,

I can run through a concise pricing overview and a short demo focused on production economics (latency/cost tradeoffs), dedicated vs hosted options, and typical deployment patterns for payments use cases.

- Mon 5/17 10:30–11:00

Hi Sam — thanks, and good catch on the conflict. I've moved us to Tue 5/18 14:00–14:30 PST and sent an updated invite (attached .ics).

For a tighter cost estimate, the items that help most:
- Expected QPS or requests/day (peak vs average)
- Typical and max sequence length for inference (tokens)
- Percent of requests requiring KV/cache warmups vs cached prefixes
- Desired p95/p99 latency SLOs and any burst tolerance
- Data residency / retention requirements and whether you need Private deployment

If you can paste those in a quick reply or drop them into the MAP we attached, we'll run a short pre-call calc and be ready to walk through tradeoffs. I've also added Dylan to coordinate logistics and follow up the MAP.

See you Tue 5/18 at 2pm PST — invite: invite-redwood-summitpay.ics
